observations: All 79 static cases and474 original frames were personally reviewed through16 uniform six-angle sheets, including fresh/intermediate/mature states, trainingquarters, opposite Fly countertraining, five coats, prior-family regressions and representative gear.

The original square head box and pixel face stay intact. Crown roots/caps remain outside the fixed head where visible. Fresh low drapes develop into short balanced flaps, Run down/forward streamers, Swim down/back streamers, near-vertical Run+Swim tips, broad Power/Power+Fly paddles, raised Fly outer points and moderate tan Power+Swim flaps.

Intermediate ages and training produce cohesive partial features; no disconnected, inverted or exposed box interior was observed in the static samples. Hands/feet remain simple compact blocks. This sampled static sequence does not by itself establish continuous motion.

Both longitudinal cap pigment regions are visibly present. The four-bar halo remains intact and separate in sampled front/sides/back/above/below views, including the raised Fly cap near the tilted halo.

Five genetic/finish examples retain the same recognizable fixed-head morphology. Red shiny and natural shiny highlights were observed in stills only; green mono and ruby maintain their underlying color identities while halo pigments follow the family.

Pumpkin hides covered head/features as intended; rabbit ears/hand/feet and Phoenix wing parts retain their recognizable attachment placements. Glasses remain aligned over the original eyes; their fine stippling is visible and is not claimed repaired by this geometry pass.

Previous Hero Run, Hero Normal, Neutral Normal, Neutral Swim, Dark Normal, Neutral Fly, Neutral Run and Neutral Power regression scenes retain recognizable completed silhouettes. Original Run head-top/crest stripes remain present; new Hero Swim does not inherit forehead or crest stripe geometry.

The strict collector verified one complete 94-scene invocation, zero skips and all802 PNG hashes. The immutable final proof verifies8358production entries across frozen/live/JAR bytes and nine previous model assets exact to delivered .63.
approximations: Four clean head cuboids approximate rounded root arches and narrow tapered leaf ends. The small Run+Fly upturned terminal nib is omitted rather than adding extra segments.
Swim/Run long features are blunt two-section streamers. Power/Fly use broad or raised rectangular caps, with simpler curvature than the source.
Original square feet and angular small tail are retained; source webbing, rounded wing lobes and body curvature are simplified.

The original 7x6x6 head remains fixed even where the viewer changes its taper or proportions. Overall source/mod proportions and lighting differ; exact Minecraft side hides planar eyes while the viewer side is slightly oblique.

Bilinear mixed profiles, stage timing and the halo whole-ring translation are authored approximations. Source paired-control appearance near 50 percent is not treated as proof of an original-game formula.
